title: Extraction body
description: The body of an extraction Artifact (#5 decision 1): what one extractor version read from one Blob, as ordered ContentBlocks. The Artifact's subject_ref is blob:<blob>. Every block id is derived from the blob, the extractor and the block's ordinal (rule block_id), and every ref lies in that blob (rule block_anchor): the Hub builds both itself and does not take them from the extractor. Open, as artifact/body.

blob.description: The Blob the blocks were read from.

id.description: The extractor; its jobs are extract.<id>.

version.description: The extractor's version; a new version reads a Blob again into a new Artifact with new block ids. No - or +, which separate it in the pipeline version.

refs.description: At least one: a block whose finer place is unknown cites the document.

warnings.description: What the extractor could not read, or read only in part; absent when there is nothing to say.

code.description: no_text_layer: pages without text, left to OCR; limit_reached: reading stopped at a limit, the rest is missing; replaced_characters: bytes that were not text in the detected encoding were replaced. Known codes are the examples; a newer Hub may send others.
